status: PROPOSED; seed list written by the auditor from fields already traced. The owner edits, adds or removes queries; the script reads this file and nothing else to decide what to ask for.
query_language: Europe PMC search syntax. The script adds the window clause FIRST_IDATE:[since TO until].

queries.query: (honeycomb OR "comb building" OR "comb cell") AND (bee OR Apis)
(thermoregulation OR "brood temperature" OR "nest temperature") AND (Apis OR honeybee)
"root water uptake" AND ("soil water potential" OR drought)
biosphere AND ("nutrient recycling" OR "biogeochemical cycl*") AND (planetary OR Earth)
